description: Empty bootstrap registry for the fresh CGBC knowledge-corpus rebaseline. No semantic concepts are carried forward automatically from Concept Registry v1; concepts become permanent only after fresh sermon evidence has been completed and normalized.

governance.principle: Capture sermon meaning from fresh evidence first; normalize globally only after the meaning is established.
governance.freshCorpusPolicy: The legacy v1 registry is not research evidence and is not an automatic source of permanent concept IDs during the fresh corpus rebaseline.
governance.candidatePolicy: Fresh sermon records may use conceptCandidates when no approved v2 concept exists. Candidate normalization is a post-research corpus step and must not require redoing Scripture research.
governance.approvalPolicy: A concept may enter the active v2 registry only after its meaning is supported by fresh canonical sermon evidence and its evidenceBasis resolves to the fresh corpus.
governance.scopeNote: The Concept Registry is semantic normalization vocabulary, not doctrine authority and not proof that a sermon teaches a concept merely because an alias matches transcript text.

legacyRegistryPolicy.notes: Legacy concepts may be independently re-established after fresh evidence is frozen; matching a v1 label or alias is not sufficient for adoption.
